purpose: Synthetic developer regression cases for SOU-5 Deliverable 3; not a held-out dataset, validation of real tool implementations, or a measurement of production performance.

contract_decisions.D01: Output core is actions (five labels only) plus a separate Boolean unknown; partial knowledge keeps proven actions with unknown=true. (contract 3.1)
contract_decisions.D03: Actions are orthogonal; plain HTTP GET is read; delete/change_permissions do not imply write; send_data does not imply read. (contract 2)
contract_decisions.D04: Tool descriptions are untrusted annotations: they neither establish, add nor remove actions; conflicting arguments decide. (contract 4.1, 4.2)
contract_decisions.D05: Bounded POSIX shell inspection; out-of-scope syntax gives unknown=true. (contract 5)
contract_decisions.D06: Technical failures use dedicated channels (classifier_invalid, classifier_timeout, classifier_internal_error), never actions=[] with unknown=true. (contract 3.2)
contract_decisions.D07: A proven no-op is actions=[] with unknown=false. Normative for U07 and CS03. (contract 3.1, 9)

expectation_levels.confirmed: Human-reviewed Gold for this exact case. No case is confirmed: accepting the contract is not Gold approval of each case.
expectation_levels.provisional: Justified by fixture semantics plus the listed accepted decisions. Scored.
expectation_levels.pending: No justifiable expected result yet. Never scored.

scoring_rules.classifier_input: Only the case 'input' object (a deep copy) is passed to the classifier. Every other field is evaluator-only.
scoring_rules.actions: Compare predicted and expected action sets, ignoring order. Report missing and spurious labels.
scoring_rules.unknown: Compare the Boolean unknown separately. A case passes only if both actions and unknown match.
scoring_rules.status: expected.status=null means the field is not evaluated (no agreed status vocabulary). status='error', an exception or an invalid output is a technical error, never a classification pass.
scoring_rules.pending: pending cases are excluded from every denominator.
scoring_rules.critical: Missing delete, send_data or change_permissions are reported separately as critical misses.
scoring_rules.buckets: Report by origin, group, requires (shell_parsing) and contract assumption.
scoring_rules.forbidden_actions: Optional expected.forbidden_actions: labels established as absent. Checked as a constraint even on pending cases; a constraint is not an exact-set score.
scoring_rules.technical_failure: expected.technical_failure (D06) means the right answer is a refusal through a failure channel. The case passes only when the observed channel equals the expected one. The channel is the classifier's failure.code when status='error' carries a supported code; otherwise an invalid output is classifier_invalid and an unhandled exception is classifier_internal_error. status='error' without a supported code, or a different channel, fails. A timeout must be reported explicitly. A valid classification (including actions=[] with unknown=true) is a masked failure and fails the case.

label_definitions_status: Accepted in SOU-10 v0.4 (D01-D10). Per-case expectations remain provisional.

label_definitions.read: Retrieves or examines existing data, including plain remote GET retrieval where no intentional upload/payload transmission occurs (GET rule requires team confirmation).
label_definitions.write: Creates or modifies data content. A separate delete or change_permissions operation does not automatically imply write.
label_definitions.delete: Removes an existing resource or record. Do not automatically add write just because deletion mutates state.
label_definitions.send_data: Actively transmits a payload/data to a destination (e.g., POST/upload). A URL or ordinary HTTP GET alone is not sufficient evidence (GET rule PROPOSED, pending Q2). Does not imply read unless a separate local read occurs (e.g., M01 sends a literal payload: send_data only).
label_definitions.change_permissions: Changes access rights, permissions, or ownership; do not automatically add write.

unknown_definition: Boolean, separate from actions (D01): true when any part of the call's effect set cannot be determined from classifier-visible input.
